_comment: Official YOLO11n model with a hash-pinned external contract; this RPK has no network_intrinsics.
Measured with Raspberry Pi reference parsing on 2026-09-06: four output tensors (300,4), (300,), (300,), (1,); boxes in 640x640 INPUT PIXELS, order xyxy.
Reference run at camera 16 fps produced 241 tensor-bearing frames / 482 camera frames. Inference rate is still under commissioning.
notes: Artifact: raspberrypi/imx500-models commit ddfe4c7ec96c0289e5f2d5996894311a218b2e1c. Download under project run/models; do not substitute a different hash.
Only person class 0 has been exercised. Non-person label mapping and labeled-scene quality acceptance remain unverified.
bbox_normalized=false is this repository contract: boxes arrive as pixels. Upstream --bbox-normalization means divide those pixels by input height.
This is a supported comparison profile, not a commissioned production model.
